''''Whisper'''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE/ph phantom]] [[TIE pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point, "Whisper" entered a dogfight, which necessitated entering cloaking mode.
